channel.description: Release feed for uPro Plus within OmniSource, curated from official upstream sources.

item.title: uPro Plus v21.38.2
item.description:
YouTube 21.38.2 | uPro Plus extra tweaks | YouMod_21.38.2_2.0.0
### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
> [!NOTE] > - **YTUHD** is not included. > - [v2.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/Tonwalter888/YouMod/releases/tag/v2.0.0) > - no standalone iSponsorBlock. (unstable in newer builds) > - - - > #### Extra Tweaks: > - `YouPip` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality` `YouGetCaption` `YTHoldForSpeed` `YTNativeShare` `YTweaks` > - `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino` `VolumeBoostYT` `PleaseDontStopTheMusic`
> [!WARNING] > - Extra tweaks that are bundled may be unstable on newer versions.
> [!WARNING] > - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.
